name: Gonzales County, TX
findings: Gonzales County has 59 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Gonzales County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Gonzales County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
